Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. It can only digivolve into a card with both the [Mineral] and [LIBERATOR] traits.
Card Q&A.q: If I would use this card's  effect to digivolve my Digimon, can it digivolve into a [Mineral] or [LIBERATOR] trait Digimon card?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 [Sunarizamon] or [Close] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Your Turn] When any of your [Close]s suspend, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of your [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Mineral] and [LIBERATOR] traits in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 3.
